purpose: Add and run a reusable live-access probe for the unresolved ACM ics26-106.zip supplement, with optional cookie support for future authorized access.

interpretation.next_required_actor: ACM-authorized user or paper author with artifact access
interpretation.next_if_access_obtained: run probe with a cookie file or downloaded zip, then inspect_xhd_acm_supplement_zip.py and the Goal5336-Goal5340 chain

pod_usage.reason: Live access/provenance probe only. POD is useful only after inspected artifacts, accepted workload mapping, and command packet readiness.

allowed_summary: Goal5341 adds a reusable live ACM supplement access probe and records that the current unauthenticated environment still receives 403 HTML responses, with no zip magic observed.
not_allowed: claiming the ACM supplement contents were inspected
claiming the ACM supplement contains datasets
claiming the ACM supplement contains no useful artifacts
running POD from this live-access probe
